entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand Pulse tracker I bought.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's a technical fault. The screen just freezes all the time. Honestly, the thing is just garbage. It doesn't work like it's supposed to at all.

I understand your frustration, and that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. A frozen screen is something our technical support team are experts at fixing. I can transfer you over to them right now to troubleshoot.
Oh, I really don't have time for all of that. I've already tried turning it on and off. I just want money back. I was really counting on this refund.
I see. Let me just pull up your order information to check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 14 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. So can I get the refund?
I understand you're looking for a refund, but according to our policy, the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window. We are currently on day 14, which is outside of that period for a return.
Oh. I... I didn't know that. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I thought it was 90 days. I really needed that money back for some bills. I saved up for this and now I'm stuck with it?

I truly am sorry about the situation. The 10-day policy is specific to the Pulse because it activates and links to your personal account. While a refund isn't an option at this point, the defect you mentioned is covered by our one-year warranty. We absolutely must solve that for you. Without verifying the fault, I can't process a return, but our technical support team can confirm the issue and get a free replacement sent out immediately.
I guess... I just don't have the energy for this right now. I really thought this would be simple. I'm so disappointed.
I understand completely. The offer to connect with technical support for a warranty replacement will be here for you whenever you're ready. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
